title: Spotlight Balance Across Players
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=campaign:session event=spotlight
| stats sum(spotlight_min) as spotlight by player
| eventstats avg(spotlight) as fair_share
| eval delta=round(spotlight-fair_share,0)
| sort delta
description: Measures how much spotlight time each player gets, helping the game master share the limelight fairly.
value: Quiet players drift away when overshadowed; a spotlight balance nudges a fairer, more engaging table.
implementation: Log spotlight minutes into `index=personal`; compare each player to the fair share.
visualization: Bar chart of spotlight time by player versus fair share.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much attention each player gets in the story, helping share the spotlight fairly.
